requiredForPublish.meaning: Search intent and original angle evidence reviewed
Material claims matched to trustworthy sources
No copying, patchwriting, or shallow reference rewrite
Search intent, headings, links, metadata reviewed
Direct answers, attribution and useful examples reviewed
Actual Sanity schema and Portable Text document accepted
Real website/Pages preview inspected, including mobile
Alt text, hierarchy, contrast, keyboard checks
Links and canonical verified without unsafe protocols
Selected primary category is live in current CMS and website

failedCheckBehavior: Return targeted issue with evidence; maximum 2 repairs; block publish
